classes.description: ERPRoute — ERP工艺路线（版本化实体）。从ERP系统下载的制造工艺路线定义，是ERP中最接近Camstar工作流(Workflow)的概念。包含多个工艺步骤(RouteStep)，每个步骤比工作流工步更粗粒度（通常在步骤级汇总）。可选择关联特定的产品(Product)。被 Workflow、MfgOrder、ERPBOM 引用，将ERP的工艺路线与Camstar'的工单和工作流桥接。 【Swagger】Schema: ERPRouteEntity；来源文件: ERPRoutes.json；API: /api/ERPRoutes。

properties.name: erpRouteBase
properties.description: ERP工艺路线基线引用

properties.name: setupAccess
properties.description: 换线设置权限 → SetupAccess 【Swagger】引用 Schema: NamedObjectRef。

properties.name: revision
properties.description: 修订版本号 【Swagger】Revision (unique within the context of the base entity)

properties.name: changeHistory
properties.description: 变更历史记录 【Swagger】引用 Schema: ChangeHistoryChanges。

properties.name: description
properties.description: 描述说明 【Swagger】Description of this entity. Defaults to the name of this entity if not specified

properties.name: isFrozen
properties.description: 是否已冻结（只读） 【Swagger】Determines if changes are allowed to this instance

properties.name: erpItem
properties.description: ERP系统对应的物料/项目编码 【Swagger】Reference to the ERP Item (usually equal to the InSite Product) that uses this route. Since a route could be used by multiple items, this is usually an optional field.

properties.name: status
properties.description: 状态：1=Active, 2=Inactive 【Swagger】Determines the current status (Active, In-Active) of this instance. Valid values and their meanings are: 1 = Active 2 = Inactive

properties.name: wipMsgDefMgr
properties.description: 关联的WIP消息定义管理器 【Swagger】引用 Schema: WIPMsgEntity。

properties.name: iconId
properties.description: 关联的图标标识 【Swagger】Identifier for the icon associated with this Base Entity

properties.name: notes
properties.description: 备注说明 【Swagger】Notations and comments associated with this object.

properties.name: eco
properties.description: 工程变更单号(ECO) 【Swagger】Engineering Change Order

properties.name: filterTags
properties.description: 分类筛选标签 【Swagger】FilterTags comma seperated list

properties.name: productBase
properties.description: 产品基线引用

properties.name: product
properties.description: 关联的产品(Product)，可选 【Swagger】引用 Schema: RevisionedObjectRef。

classes.description: RouteStep — ERP工艺步骤（ERPRoute 的子实体）。ERP工艺路线中的单个步骤，包含ERP工序代码(ERPOperation)、执行顺序(Sequence)、名称(Name)，以及SMT贴片相关参数（isSMTSide、isSMTDate、isTransferType 等）和产能计算参数（isSetupTime、isDurationPerUnit、isUnitsPerHour 等）。被 WorkflowStep 和物料清单行引用，用于将ERP步骤映射到具体工步和物料消耗位置。 【Swagger】Schema: RouteStepChanges；来源文件: ERPRoutes.json；API: /api/ERPRoutes。

properties.name: name
properties.description: 步骤名称 【Swagger】Unique name (within the particular ERP Route) for this step

properties.name: isFrozen
properties.description: 是否已冻结（只读） 【Swagger】Determines if changes are allowed to this instance (or any of its revisions)

properties.name: erpRouteId
properties.description: 物理字段 ERPRouteID → ERPRoute

properties.name: description
properties.description: 描述说明 【Swagger】Description of this step

properties.name: erpOperation
properties.description: ERP工序操作代码 【Swagger】ERP Operation for this step. An ERP operation is similar in concept to an InSite operation.

properties.name: sequence
properties.description: 执行顺序号 【Swagger】Sequence of this step. In cases where an ERP Operation by convention is only used once in a route, sequence is usually equal to ERP Operation.

properties.name: schedulingOperation
properties.description: 排程操作代码(SchedulingOperation) 【Swagger】Scheduling Operation for this step. An Scheduling operation is similar in concept to an InSite operation.
